hero.title: Your salesperson that never sleeps
hero.subtitle: Aria answers every call, books appointments, sends WhatsApp/SMS reminders, qualifies leads, and recovers lost customers. All automatically, even when you're closed.

features.title: What Aria does
features.subtitle: A complete AI agent that adapts to your business.

items.d: 24/7 in any language, never misses a call
Checks availability and creates events in real-time
Targeted questions, budget and urgency assessment
Identifies cold leads and re-engages them

steps.title: Aria answers
steps.say: Hello! This is Aria. How can I help you?

steps.title: Appointment request
steps.user: I'd like to book an appointment for a consultation.

steps.title: Slot found
steps.say: I have tomorrow at 10:00 AM. Does that work?

steps.title: Lead saved
steps.say: Thank you, have a great day!

steps.title: Aria answers
steps.say: Hello! This is Aria from Aria Automation. How can I help you?

steps.title: Customer interest
steps.user: I'd like to learn more about your services.

steps.title: Needs assessment
steps.say: Of course! What exactly do you need?

steps.title: Problem description
steps.user: We miss many calls and can't manage everything.

steps.title: Budget inquiry
steps.say: I understand. Do you have a monthly budget in mind?

steps.title: Timeline
steps.say: Perfect. When would you like to start?

steps.title: Urgency
steps.user: As soon as possible, we need a quick solution.

steps.title: Qualified
steps.say: Got it! An operator will contact you today. Thanks!

steps.title: Outbound call
steps.say: Hi Sarah! This is Aria from Aria Automation. How are you?

steps.title: Customer remembers
steps.user: Oh yes, I remember. We hadn't decided yet.

steps.title: Targeted offer
steps.say: I understand. Can I ask: is the missed calls problem still open? We've activated a special promotion.

steps.title: Interest reborn
steps.user: Yes, the problem is still there. What is it about?

steps.title: Offer sent
steps.msg: Hi Sarah! As promised, here are the details of our special promotion: 1st month free + 20% discount for the first 3 months. If you have questions, I'm here! 🚀
steps.say: If you activate this week, we offer you the 1st month free and 20% discount for 3 months.

steps.title: Interest confirmed
steps.body: Customer interested but needs to consult.
steps.user: Interesting! I need to talk to my partner.

steps.title: Call proposal
steps.say: Of course. Can I schedule a call with our operator for tomorrow afternoon? They can answer all your questions.

steps.title: Appointment confirmed
steps.msg: Perfect Sarah! I confirm the call with our operator for tomorrow at 4:00 PM. We'll call you at your usual number. Have a great day! 📞
steps.say: Perfect. I'll send you a reminder one hour before. See you tomorrow!
